name: Booty Bay
summary: In Booty Bay, goblins keep a neutral port open to Alliance and Horde alike. The Steamwheedle Cartel's Blackwater Raiders hold this harbor in southern Stranglethorn Vale, where travelers enter by land through a giant shark's jaws.

sections.title: A Den of Scoundrels and Profit
sections.body:
Booty Bay began as the human settlement of Blackwater Cove. Jungle trolls took it, then goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel captured it. Now merchants, outcasts, and scoundrels come here from many lands. Baron Revilgaz and Fleet Master Seahorn watch the port from the balconies of the Salty Sailor Tavern.

The harbor may seem lawless, but the cartel keeps order. Anyone may drink, trade, or hire mercenaries, so long as they respect the cartel's peace and pay the harbor fees.

sections.title: Threats on the Water
sections.body: Booty Bay's docks link the Eastern Kingdoms with ratchet across the Great Sea. Trade and travelers pass between the continents here. Such wealth draws enemies. The Bloodsail Buccaneers are a hostile pirate fleet that raids Blackwater shipping and prowls the Stranglethorn coast. They plot to destroy and plunder the goblin port.

aliases: who is in charge of booty bay
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz rules Booty Bay for the Steamwheedle Cartel, alongside Fleet Master Seahorn, the tauren commander of the Blackwater Raiders. They direct their operations from the Salty Sailor Tavern's upper decks, above the harbor.

faq.q: Why can Alliance and Horde players stand together here?
faq.answer: The neutral Steamwheedle Cartel values profit and trade above the Alliance and Horde conflict. It welcomes anyone with coin. When someone starts a brawl, goblin bruisers go after them.

aliases: why do bloodsail hate booty bay
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers are an outlaw syndicate at war with the Blackwater Raiders. Their ships command the waters off southern Stranglethorn Vale, and they plot to overwhelm Booty Bay and seize its lucrative harbor.

faq.q: Where does the boat in Booty Bay sail?
faq.answer: The passenger vessel from Booty Bay's lower docks crosses the Great Sea to ratchet in the Barrens. It is the main neutral passage between the southern Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the giant statue standing at the bay's entrance?
faq.answer: An unknown goblin with outstretched arms is carved into the massive statue at Janeiro's Point, just outside the harbor mouth. It guides merchant ships and pirate crews as a beacon and welcoming monument.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find underworld contacts, fences, lockboxes, and covert informants in Booty Bay. They trade secrets for coin.
Far south of Stormwind's protected borders, Booty Bay offers you neutral amenities, flight routes, and ship passage straight to Kalimdor.
